build_COCOProjNet: build a PyTorch neural network that projects images and sentences into a shared embedding space for COCO image-text matching
create_PairwiseRankingLoss: create a pairwise ranking loss module with a margin to penalize incorrect image-sentence pairs during training
run_ImageSentenceRankingPytorch: run image-sentence ranking training and evaluation on COCO data with early stopping and retrieval metrics
test_i2t: test image-to-text retrieval by ranking captions for each query image and computing recall at 1, 5, and 10
review_t2i: review text-to-image retrieval by ranking images for each query caption and computing recall at 1, 5, and 10
